rules.rule: Root whole-order logical deletion is atomic per exact owned order; preserve history, other orders, current permissions and full-range counts.
rules.source: User approved 2026-11-12 Root single/batch cockpit deletion with historical retention and two reviewed UI mockups; docs/engineering/root-whole-order-delete.md; no onsite deletion/deployment or original PR03.
rules.initialization: 0287 additive immutable deletion scope/request ledger; current native receiving guard retained with a same-order audited exception. Real isolated full migrations, original role seeder, no triggers disabled. Historical shared batches are refused atomically instead of deleting unrelated facts.
rules.dateAndPermission: Current Root is rechecked in each transaction. Audit cancellation time does not synthesize actual completion or reset frozen windows. Same actor after revocation is rejected; existing authorized full-range reads filter deleted IDs before counts/pages; no cached authorization.
rules.expectation: Current Root-only whole-order deletion preserves native facts, original amount/quantity semantics, unrelated scopes, atomic rollback and partial retry. Review fixes invalidate packing aliases and filter both misc association kinds before LIMIT. Full failures closed together: original browser UUID helper, explicit absent-schema legacy mocks, designated Acceptance-clock test database without loosening guards, seven peer KPIs plus the Root operation column, and native88 physical SQL <=7100. Active object IDs are reused only in the same caller-owned RR read snapshot and cleared on exit; ordinary reads retain atomic deletion predicates before Root/role shortcuts. Twelve PG/App checks, complete compatibility/cache regression, and native88 role/page/search/export/revocation counterexamples have independent actual reports. Unrelated homepage cases deliberately filtered locally; not claimed passed on this candidate. Historical ambiguous shared batches remain explicitly refused unchanged, not false success.
